FunctionPlot.signature: FunctionPlot(title: string, parameterId: string, family: "linear" | "quadratic" | "exponential", minX: number, maxX: number)
FunctionPlot.description: Educational finite function plot driven by a Slider with the same parameterId. No expressions or code.

EvidenceView.description: Actual host-collected evidence and claim audit. IDs must resolve; generated claims are never accepted as audit metadata.

SeriesChart.signature: SeriesChart(title: string, series: {name: string, points: {label: string, value: number}[]}[])
SeriesChart.description: Compare supplied series locally; each series can be hidden. Values must be supplied together with their series and label.

SourceChart.description: Chart exact host-bound values from a numeric two-column table in the authoritative answer; never transcribe or invent values.

SourceCode.description: Read-only exact code from a closed fence in the authoritative answer. Never transcribe, edit or execute it.

Calculator.signature: Calculator(id: string, title: string, operation: "add" | "multiply" | "divide" | "power", a: number, b: number)
Calculator.description: Local bounded arithmetic; never executes code.

Chart.signature: Chart(title: string, kind: "bar" | "line" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", points: {label: string, value: number, x?: number}[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
Chart.description: Chart of supplied values; never invent data.

Diagram.signature: Diagram(title: string, nodes: {id: string, label: string, detail?: string}[], edges: {from: string, to: string, label?: string}[])

Timeline.signature: Timeline(title: string, events: {date: string, title: string, detail?: string}[])

Quiz.signature: Quiz(id: string, title: string, questions: {question: string, options: string[], answer: number, explanation: string}[])

Flashcard.signature: Flashcard(id: string, front: string, back: string)

InteractiveExample.signature: InteractiveExample(id: string, kind: "sorting" | "binary-search" | "lru" | "bfs" | "dfs" | "sql-join" | "gradient-descent", values: number[], target?: number, capacity?: number, edges?: any[])

Slider.signature: Slider(id: string, label: string, min: number, max: number, value: number, step?: number)

Toggle.signature: Toggle(id: string, label: string, value: boolean)

Select.signature: Select(id: string, label: string, options: string[], value: string)

Input.signature: Input(id: string, label: string, value: string)
Input.description: Local text field. Never sends hidden requests.

FilePreview.signature: FilePreview(path: string, code: string, language?: string)
FilePreview.description: Literal code sample with display-only path.

FileTree.description: Display-only file list; no filesystem access.

SourceCard.signature: SourceCard(citationId: string, title: string, summary?: string)
SourceCard.description: Reference an actual evidence ID from the answer. Never invent IDs.

Markdown.description: A block of Markdown text. Use for prose, explanations and formatted text inside the UI.

Callout.description: A highlighted note for a warning, tip, success or error the user should notice.

CodeBlock.description: A labeled block of source code or terminal output.

Stat.signature: Stat(label: string, value: string, detail?: string)
Stat.description: A single metric with a label and an optional detail line.

Table.signature: Table(columns: string[], rows: (string | number)[][], id?: string)
Table.description: A simple data table. Use instead of a Markdown table when the data is the focus.

List.description: A short bulleted list of plain-text items.

KeyValue.description: Label/value pairs such as settings, status fields or metadata.

Progress.signature: Progress(label: string, percent: number, detail?: string)
Progress.description: A progress bar for completion, usage or quota values.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: {type: "continue_conversation", message?: string} | {type: "open_url", url: string}, variant?: "primary" | "secondary")
Button.description: A clickable button for suggested follow-ups or opening a link. Place one or a small row at the end of a UI block.

Divider.description: A thin horizontal rule separating sections.

Section.description: A titled panel grouping related content.

Columns.description: Places children side by side, wrapping on narrow widths. Ideal for a row of Stat cards.

Card.description: A titled group of related content.

Stack.signature: Stack(children: (FunctionPlot | EvidenceView | SeriesChart | SourceChart | SourceCode | Calculator | Chart | Diagram | Timeline | Quiz | Flashcard | InteractiveExample | Slider | Toggle | Select | Input | FilePreview | FileTree | DiffViewer | SourceCard | Heading | Text | Markdown | Callout | CodeBlock | Stat | Table | List | KeyValue | Progress | Button | Divider | Card)[])

Row.signature: Row(children: (FunctionPlot | EvidenceView | SeriesChart | SourceChart | SourceCode | Calculator | Chart | Diagram | Timeline | Quiz | Flashcard | InteractiveExample | Slider | Toggle | Select | Input | FilePreview | FileTree | DiffViewer | SourceCard | Heading | Text | Markdown | Callout | CodeBlock | Stat | Table | List | KeyValue | Progress | Button | Divider | Card)[])
Row.description: Content in a wrapping horizontal row.
